g.text: Member C - Grounding and independent Risk Review
no invented order or Risk outcome
bounded recovery, no fabricated source or PASS
bounded recovery, no inferred valid citations
C04 Validate complete material and bindings;
No new current proposal / no partial review;
Discard for current use; obsolete reply, timeout,
retry or exhaustion cannot alter newer round
Bounded technical recovery of selected invocation;
never fabricate PASS or a sixth outcome
C07 Present current packet and any warnings;
only if other Domain guards also pass
within budget -> new proposal/version and review;
budget exhausted -> explicit escalation, no fake outcome
C10 Show BLOCK findings to Founder;
current proposal may be revised or handled manually;
NO_MATCH is a typed empty result.
Port error is a technical error.
Check exact location, version and hash
C05 Separate prompt and model invocation;
One admitted analysis round. Revision/clarification schedules a separately guarded round.
Only Domain writes business state. PASS is not approval. No operation is dispatched here.
Source-policy conflict != pre-proposal OrderLookupBlock != technical ProcessingFailure.
